_approach: Offbeat double-kick 'gallop': the 4/4 kick is shadowed by a softer kick on the 16th before each beat (da-DUM), the trick Studio Brootle traces from Liebing-era schranz to Sara Landry. Bar 2 thins the gallop to beats 2 and 4 and adds a double before the downbeat. Sharp offbeat closed hats only. Reference: Klangkuenstler & Sant 'Toter Schmetterling', Marco Leckbert 'Schranz Will Never Die'. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
